scan.mmap_flags: MAP_PRIVATE only — do NOT use MAP_POPULATE. MAP_POPULATE forces synchronous page table walk for all 2.28GB even on hot runs, adding 84ms of overhead. Without it, pages fault on demand during the scan, overlapping with computation.
scan.madvise: MADV_SEQUENTIAL on all columns for OS prefetch. Additionally call madvise(MADV_HUGEPAGE) on each mapping to use transparent huge pages, reducing TLB misses across the 2.28GB working set.

block_classification.all_pass: max_date <= threshold → aggregate entire block without per-row date check
block_classification.partial: scan rows individually with per-row predicate

key_encoding.description: Use a 256-entry uint8_t lookup table for each of returnflag and linestatus. returnflag: A→0, N→1, R→2. linestatus: F→0, O→1. Combined key = rf_idx * 2 + ls_idx. Max index = 5, allocate 6 slots.

accumulators_per_group.sum_disc_price: double — simple addition, no Kahan. Compute as extendedprice * (1 - discount)
accumulators_per_group.sum_charge: double — simple addition, no Kahan. Compute as extendedprice * (1 - discount) * (1 + tax)

aggregation.struct_size_note: 6 doubles + 1 int64_t = 56 bytes per group. No Kahan compensation fields — reduces struct from 64 to 56 bytes, improving cache utilization.
aggregation.avg_computation: deferred to finalize: avg = sum / count

parallelism.merge: sum thread-local accumulator arrays (6 slots each) into global result — trivial, only iterate over actual thread count
parallelism.thread_local_layout: Allocate per-thread accumulators as a flat array with 64-byte alignment and padding between thread slots to avoid false sharing. Use at most nproc slots, not a fixed 256.

data_structures.aggregation: fixed_array(6 slots per thread, indexed by compact key)
data_structures.thread_local_accumulators: Dynamically sized array[nproc][6] with cache-line padding between thread slots. Each Accum struct is 56 bytes (no Kahan fields).

output.sort_strategy: trivial — iterate compact keys 0..5 in order, output non-empty groups

optimization_notes: Category A+C optimization. Root cause: data_loading phase consumed 84ms (69% of 121ms total) due to MAP_POPULATE forcing synchronous page table setup for 2.28GB of column data, even on hot runs when pages are already in page cache. Fix 1: Remove MAP_POPULATE from all mmap calls — pages will fault on demand during the scan phase, overlapping I/O with computation. Fix 2: Add MADV_HUGEPAGE to reduce TLB misses across the 2.28GB working set (with 4KB pages, 2.28GB needs ~580K TLB entries; with 2MB huge pages, only ~1140). Fix 3: Remove Kahan summation — eliminates 4 extra FP ops per row (~236M total ops), reduces accumulator struct from 64 to 56 bytes. These changes should eliminate the data_loading bottleneck and reduce scan time, targeting sub-35ms total.
